title: Bang Bang Shrimp Pasta
description: This is the easiest bang bang recipe ever! All you have to do is roast some shrimp in a little bit of paprika for the smoky flavor, and while that’s in the oven, you can boil your pasta and make the creamy bang bang sauce. Once that’s done, you can toss those together for the creamiest pastas of all time, giving you a kick of heat and refreshing tangy goodness!
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti or thin spaghetti, broken in half or thirds
8-12 ounces medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 teaspoon smoked paprika, or more, to taste
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1/2 cup mayonnaise (or Greek yogurt or sour cream)
Juice of 1/2 lime, or more, to taste
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
directions: To make the sauce, whisk together mayonnaise, Thai sweet chili sauce, garlic, lime juice, Sriracha and red pepper flakes; set aside.
In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta according to package instructions; drain well.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Lightly oil a baking sheet or coat with nonstick spray.

Place shrimp onto the prepared baking sheet. Add olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper, to taste, and gently toss to combine. Place into oven and roast just until pink, firm and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine pasta, shrimp and mayonnaise mixture.
